scenarios.name: Place an order
scenarios.reason: The confirmation charged €13.00 and contained no €4.90 shipping charge or €17.90 bag total.
scenarios.diagnosis: The test was set up with the wrong expected shipping cost and total. The store advertises free shipping from €0.50, and this €13.00 order qualified, so charging €13.00 matched the bag and checkout.
scenarios.suggestion: Correct the test's shipping rule and expected total to €13.00 for this order, or change the cart/test fixture only if €4.90 shipping is genuinely intended.

scenarios.name: Free shipping from €50
scenarios.reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "shipping is €4.90 and the total is €49.40"
scenarios.diagnosis: The cart is applying free shipping to a €44.50 subtotal, even though this order is expected to have a €4.90 delivery charge.
scenarios.suggestion: Review the cart's free-shipping threshold and shipping-charge calculation. For a €44.50 basket containing House Espresso and Paper Filters, show €4.90 shipping and a €49.40 total; after one additional Paper Filters unit, show free shipping and €51.00.

scenarios.name: What the PR description asks
scenarios.reason: Child agent failed: The homepage visibly says free shipping from €0.50, not €50.
scenarios.diagnosis: The shipping threshold value is being shown with the decimal point in the wrong place, so 50 is displayed as 0.50.
scenarios.suggestion: Correct the displayed shipping threshold so the homepage says “Free shipping from €50,” then verify the value in a browser.
